title: Cheap!
text: Cheap!. These are extremely cheap glasses. The quality is horrible. Several of them are crooked and lopsided. I had these sent to me from Libbey directly becuase I had ordered another style and several of them broke due to poor design. I will never buy from this company again. The customer service was decent but what does it matter if the quality is not good.
